content.short: Opshin is a toolchain that allows developers to write Cardano smart contracts using the Python language.
content.description: Opshin is a groundbreaking development toolchain that enables the creation of Cardano smart contracts using Python, one of the world's most popular programming languages. By providing a strict subset of Python that compiles directly to Plutus, Opshin significantly lowers the barrier to entry for developers who are unfamiliar with Haskell. The platform ensures that if a program runs in Python, it will behave identically on the blockchain, prioritizing security and predictability. Opshin is a vital initiative for ecosystem growth, empowering a wider pool of builders to innovate on Cardano.
content.meta: Opshin enables Cardano smart contract development using Python to improve builder accessibility. Explore it on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
